rows.name: Results jump (india-results-drift rule)
rows.author: pack
rows.hypothesis: A 4%+ move on quarterly results on 2x turnover, closing near the high, keeps drifting up (post-earnings drift) while NIFTY is above its 200-day average.

rows.name: Delivery accumulation near the 52-week high
rows.author: claude
rows.hypothesis: Rising delivery % (real buyers taking shares home) on rising turnover, within reach of the 52-week high in an uptrend, precedes breakouts.

rows.name: Relative-strength momentum in uptrends
rows.author: pack
rows.hypothesis: The strongest stocks vs NIFTY over 20 sessions, with the 50-day above the 200-day average, keep outperforming over the next 10 sessions.

rows.name: Pullback to the 20-day in a strong uptrend
rows.author: claude
rows.hypothesis: In stocks whose 50-day is well above the 200-day, a dip below the 20-day average that turns up (an up close) resumes the trend.

rows.name: Sector leaders (india-swing-desk rule)
rows.author: pack
rows.hypothesis: Stocks ahead of an industry that is itself 2+ points ahead of NIFTY and strengthening keep outperforming for two weeks, while NIFTY is above its 200-day average.

rows.name: Oversold bounce in long-term uptrends
rows.author: claude
rows.hypothesis: A sharp 5-session drop in a stock still above its 200-day average, with a strong close today and VIX not extreme, mean-reverts within a week.

rows.name: Futures long buildup with price above the 50-day
rows.author: claude
rows.hypothesis: Price and open interest rising together over 5 sessions (fresh longs) above the 50-day average, in a healthy market, continues for a week.
